name: Emote Wheel & Armor
description: Fortnite-style emote wheel with 310+ emotes (dances, poses, anime moves, cat & maid), optional particle FX, a live preview, a customizable wheel, favorites and rebindable keys. Also includes the Hinata and maid armor outfits (rename diamond/netherite armor). Install on the server too so other players can see your emotes. Includes 3D jutsu props, ear/tail/pet options and owner-only toggles.
